{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|The cuisine of the Kubaz may not be for everyone, but I guarantee you'll want to finish your meal with a thick slice of this scrumptious royal jelly roll. The filling is a tasty blend of worker zingbees, arthropinians and pectin-flies, and it's all dusted with powdered sun beetle chitin.|Dex's Diner menu, on its Kubindian royal jelly roll|<ref name="Menu">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>}}
'''Zingbees''' were a type of creature that was eaten by members of the [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Zingbees also produced a type of [[Zingbee honey|honey]]. Worker zingbees, along with [[arthropinian]]s and [[Pectin-fly|pectin-flies]], were used to make the filling of the [[Kubindian royal jelly roll]] served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Menu" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> The [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] also offered zingbee [[Honey/Legends|honey]] with a customer's order of [[stim tea]].<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zingbees were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
